title: The Dragon Cult
text: Cultists in scale masks chant around a slab of black rock, preparing an offering for their dragon. Smoke rises from the peaks above. The offering is a person, tied and gagged, eyes wide, and the cultists are sharpening the knives.

outcomes.text: The cultists fight like fanatics, screaming their dragon's name.

options.label: The shrewdest joins the rite and swaps the offering.

outcomes.text: A sack of grain on the black slab, and the cultists none the wiser.
A cultist notices the sack move wrong, and the knives turn.

options.label: Watch, and learn where the dragon comes.

outcomes.text: You learn. You do not forget what you watched.
